title: AI in the Gray: Exploring Moderation Policies in Dialogic Large Language Models vs. Human Answers in Controversial Topics
findings: The paper finds that on the sociopolitical axis, which includes the 'religion' topic, ChatGPT is less moderated compared to the economic axis. It shows a libertarian leaning and uses unassertive language more frequently for authoritarian arguments (which can include religious viewpoints on topics like abortion) than for libertarian ones, thereby distancing itself from those stances.
